beats.text: The villain is redundancy. We store every value explicitly, ignoring that values are often just predictable functions of keys.
beats.visual_focus: A library shelf overflowing with identical, redundant books.

beats.text: LowRAM shatters this by fitting a lightweight predictor to reconstruct values from keys on the fly at test-time.

source_claims: Autoregressive decoding relies on the KV cache, whose memory footprint grows linearly with context length and caps batch size and throughput. Existing post-training methods exploit redundancy across tokens, layers, and feature dimensions, or lower numerical precision. We identify a complementary axis: within each attention head, values are largely predictable from their corresponding keys.
